# Best MagSafe car mounts (Qi2)

**Best for most iPhone drivers: Belkin BoostCharge Qi2 15W Vent Mount (about $47.99)**
- Several roundups pick it as the best all-rounder. It includes a USB-C cable and a 27W car adapter, rotates between portrait and landscape, and fits cases up to 3 mm thick.
- Check your vents first. Belkin says slats should be no more than 3 mm thick and 20 mm deep. Horizontal slats work best, and vertical ones can droop.
- Sources: [RottenWiFi](https://rottenwifi.com/best-magsafe-car-mounts-in-2026-connect-charge-and-drive/), [iTechGuides](https://www.itechguides.com/best-magsafe-car-mounts-in-2026-connect-charge-and-drive/)

**Best for fast charging and heat: Anker Prime Qi2 25W with cooling (A2933), $89.99**
- It has a thermoelectric cooler plus a fan, and MountGuys uses it as their own daily driver. The Gadgeteer listed it at $69.99 on sale, so check the current price.
- Phone limits apply. It gives up to 25W on the iPhone 17 and 16 Pro Max/Plus, 22W on the iPhone 16 and 16 Pro, and about 15W on the iPhone 15 and earlier.
- It is not compatible with Tesla or Mercedes-Benz vehicles. Sources disagree on the adapter: MountGuys and the Gadgeteer say a 60W adapter is in the box, while others say you need a 45W+ adapter, so confirm before buying.
- Sources: [MountGuys](https://www.mountguys.com/best-magsafe-car-mount/), [The Gadgeteer](https://the-gadgeteer.com/2026/06/16/best-magsafe-car-mounts-iphone-2026/)

**Best value with a fan: ESR HaloLock 15W CryoBoost**
- It is Qi2-certified, mounts on a vent or dash, and has a cooling fan.
- Dealectric lists it at $39.99, or $32.80 with code PARTNER18 (expires 2026-12-31). [Buy here](https://dealectric.com/go/esr-halolock-15w-wireless-car-charger-cryoboost). This is an affiliate link, so Dealectric is paid if you buy.
- Dealectric doesn't say whether a car adapter is included, and the Gadgeteer says it isn't, so budget $10–15 for one. The Gadgeteer also lists a version at $18.99, so compare prices.
- Source: [Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/answers/best-magsafe-car-charger-mount-2026-reviews-qi2)

**Other options**
- **LISEN Qi2.2 25W with fan (from $39.95):** The Gadgeteer ranks it best overall for iPhone 16/17, and it includes a 95W adapter. The fan-off mode caps output at 15W. [The Gadgeteer](https://the-gadgeteer.com/2026/06/16/best-magsafe-car-mounts-iphone-2026/)
- **LISEN 15W vent/dash mount ($15.99):** It is the cheapest pick, and the listing needs a charger that supplies at least 18W per port. I couldn't confirm Qi2 certification for it.
- **VICSEED steel-core vent mount (no charging):** Choose this if you don't want a power cable. MountGuys picked it from research rather than hands-on testing. [MountGuys](https://www.mountguys.com/best-magsafe-car-mount/)

I don't have direct product URLs for the Belkin, Anker or LISEN listings. Each article above has "Buy on Amazon" buttons for them.

**Quick pick:** Get the Belkin if your vents suit it. Get the Anker if you have a recent Pro iPhone and run navigation in hot weather. Get the ESR if you want to spend less.
